Press Note: Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination, 2024

Date: 19/03/2024

The Union Public Service Commission has decided to postpone the Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination, 2024 which was scheduled to be held on 26th May, 2024.

Due to the schedule of the impending General Election, the Commission has decided to hold the said Examination on 16th June, 2024.

Candidates are advised to regularly visit the official UPSC website for latest updates regarding the examination timetable and e-Admit cards.
